{{Top}} {{Update|[[Poe Dameron 9]], [[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]}} {{Character |type=Criminal |image=[[File:Razoo_Qin-Fee.png]] |name=Razoo Qin-Fee |homeworld=[[Nar Kanji]]''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' |birth= |death=[[34 ABY]], ''[[Eravana]]''{{HelmetCollectionCite|52|Weapons & Uniforms}} |species=[[Human]]{{Film|VII}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{Databank|razoo-qin-fee|Razoo Qin-Fee}} |pronouns=He/him |height=1.65 [[meter]]s''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Tanned |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=[[Kanjiklub]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|We're going to take that droid, and you're going to give us our money back."
"Or your dead body. Your choice, Solo.|Bala-Tik and Qin-Fee speak to Han Solo while searching for the fugitives he is hiding|[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' novelization]]}} '''Razoo Qin-Fee''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Nar Kanji]], who served as a [[Lieutenant (criminal)|lieutenant]] in the criminal gang [[Kanjiklub]] around 30 years after the [[Battle of Endor]]. He was a pyromaniac and technical expert and was in charge of assembling and maintaining Kanjiklub's wide range of weapons and [[armor]]s. The [[underworld Zygerrian fighting circuit]] expelled Qin-Fee for cheating. He carried a [["Wasp" blaster rifle]] for use in battle. He and the other gang members and the [[Guavian Death Gang]] confronted the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] over fifty thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] he owed them on board the [[Baleen-class heavy freighter]] ''[[Eravana]]''. The two gangs realized that Solo was also transporting the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]] and two fugitives from the [[First Order]] on board the [[freighter]] and began searching for them, but were interrupted and prevented from [[Death|killing]] Solo when three [[rathtar]]s, Solo's inadvertently released cargo, attacked both groups. Though not one to shy away from a fight, Qin-Fee wisely decided that this foe was beyond his capabilities and promptly ran for his life, but was ultimately caught and devoured. In the confusion created by the rathtars, Solo and the fugitives managed to escape from the ''Eravana''. ==Biography== Razoo Qin-Fee was a native of the [[planet]] [[Nar Kanji]] who was banned from the [[underworld Zygerrian fighting circuit]] for cheating, despite the fact that the sport lacked any rules. He became a member of the criminal [[Kanjiklub]] gang who operated out of Nar Kanji, and by thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], served as a [[Lieutenant (criminal)|lieutenant]] and second-in-command to the gang's [[topboss]]''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]'' [[Tasu Leech]]. Qin-Fee was responsible for the maintenance of the gang's mismatched weapons and [[armor]], and regularly modified them to the other gang member's specifications. After the [[Kanjiklub]] gang defeated forces of the [[Guavian Death Gang]] during the [[skirmish in the Cronese Mandate]], Qin-Fee obtained the ''[[Smuggler's Guide]]'' that was previously owned by [[Bala-Tik]] and wrote an entry in it, where he claimed that the train of [[freighter]]s containing items they [[Thief|stole]] stretched back to [[Foran Tutha]]. Later in the [[book]] he described how they once fought at the [[Chasidron Shoals]] where they "knocked their challengers stupid" and threatened [[Black Sun]], [[Crymorah Syndicate]] and [[Crimson Dawn]] as being next, citing that [[Hutt]]s are already "spiraling into a crash" and that Kanjiklub will make sure there are no survivors. Tasu Leech ordered that Kanjiklub should make a deal with the weapon makers and that they'll set off to [[Cantonica]] in the morning, which Qin-Fee recorded. However, the ''Smuggler's Guide'' was stolen from the [[Unidentified Kanjiklub chief|Kanjiklub chief]] by the [[Master Codebreaker]] in the middle of negotiations for the domination of Rim territories. After the Kanjiklub leant the [[smuggler]]s [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]] fifty thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to capture [[rathtar]]s for [[King]] [[Grevoth Prana IX|Prana]], Qin-Fee was amongst a group of gang members who accompanied Leech to reclaim the loan from Solo. The gang boarded Solo's [[Baleen-class heavy freighter|''Baleen''-class heavy freighter]] ''[[Eravana]]'' above the [[planet]] [[Jakku]], and found Solo in the [[Starship|ship's]] airlock arguing with the [[Guavian Death Gang]], another criminal faction he had borrowed from. Leech and [[Bala-Tik]], leader of the Death Gang, both demanded their money back from the smugglers, but then took interest in the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]], who was stood with Solo and matched the description of a [[droid]] the [[First Order]] were looking for alongside two fugitives. Suspecting the fugitives were also onboard, Qin-Fee stepped forward and another member of Kanjiklub began searching the airlock with an [[illuminator]]. [[File:Han_Solo_confronted_by_gangs.png|thumb|left|300px|Qin-Fee and the rest of Kanjiklub confronted Solo onboard the ''Eravana''.]] As the criminals searched, Solo attempted to stall for time by claiming the droid was his and not the one being searched for, but Bala-Tik saw through the lie and demanded that Solo hand over BB-8 and the fugitives. Qin-Fee offered the alternative that Solo simply die, which earned a laugh from several other criminals, before the lights of the airlock corridor began flickering, accompanied by unearthly noises. Uncertain of this new development, the Death Gang and Kanjiklub prepared to kill Solo and Chewbacca and take the droid, but were interrupted when both criminal factions were attacked from behind by the rathtars, which had accidentally been let loose by the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] and the former [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]]; the fugitives that the criminals were searching for. Qin-Fee fled down the corridor away from the rathtar, but paused when he passed a pair of Guavians fleeing in the opposite direction. He then hailed another Kanjiklub member to approach him, but quickly decided to follow the Guavians after the gang member was grabbed by a rathtar. He then encountered another two Kanjiklub members and briefly conversed with them, deciding to avoid both ends of the airlock and head down a third corridor. His comrades were then devoured by another rathtar and Qin-Fee was forced to flee alone in the opposite direction from the Kanjiklub's starship, leaving his only hope of survival to circle back around and avoid the rathtars. This strategy failed to save Qin-Fee, who was devoured by the rathtars along with all of his comrades on board. Solo, Chewbacca and the fugitives managed to escape the ''Eravana'' onboard the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', [[Death|killing]] one of the three rathtars on the heavy [[freighter]] as they left. ==Personality and traits== Qin-Fee was an unpleasant [[human]] [[Gender|male]] pyromaniac and technological expert who earned a dangerous reputation in the underworld Zygerrian fighting circuit. As second-in-command to Tasu Leech, Qin-Fee had his eyes set on assuming the role of Kanjiklub leader, though he knew he needed to make many allies first so that he would not be quickly overthrown by other members of the gang.''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' While fleeing the rathtars on the ''Eravana'', he was terrified for his life, only taking solace in the fact that Solo would most likely be killed by the beasts. He wore his [[Color|black]] [[hair]] in a [[Zygerrian]]-style faux crest, and had brown [[eye]]s and tanned skin. ==Equipment== While onboard the ''Eravana'', Qin-Fee wore a set of patchwork armor, including a [[bandolier]] of homemade explosive cylinders and a pair of insulated palm sparring [[glove]]s. He used a [["Wasp" blaster rifle]] in combat and carried an illuminator. ==Behind the scenes== Razoo Qin-Fee was portrayed by [[Iko Uwais]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], which names him as "Razoo Quin-Fee" in the credits. He had no dialogue in the film, but received lines in its [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|novelization]] written by [[Alan Dean Foster]], also briefly serving as a point of view character. There are several discrepancies between the amount of dialogue in the novel and the film, but as Qin-Fee's line takes place at a time in the novel which does not contradict the timeline of the conversation in the film, this article assumes it is [[canon]]ical. ==Appearances== *[[Poe Dameron 9|''Poe Dameron'' 9]] *{{Film|VII}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' novelization]] {{Ab|Star Wars: The Force Awakens (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Force Awakens: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} *[[The Force Awakens Adaptation 2|''The Force Awakens Adaptation'' 2]] ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'' ==Sources== *{{Topps|set=2012 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 1|cardname=Razoo Qin-Fee (Kanjiklub Lieutenant)}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|36|Databank A-Z}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' *{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars: The Force Awakens Series 1|cardname=Razoo Qin-Fee}} *''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' *{{HelmetCollectionCite|31|Databank A-Z}} {{Po}} {{SourceContents|issue={{HelmetCollectionCite|52|parent=1}}|contents= *{{HelmetCollectionCite|52|Highlights of the Saga}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|52|Weapons & Uniforms}} }} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *{{Topps|set=2017 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Reborn|cardname=Razoo Qin-Fee|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/135181/cid/10118898}} *''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A -
